movies.title: Heat
movies.description: A master thief and the obsessive LAPD detective hunting him find themselves locked in a tense cat-and-mouse game across Los Angeles, culminating in one of cinema's greatest confrontations.

movies.title: Scarface
movies.description: A Cuban refugee claws his way to the top of Miami's cocaine empire, only for his paranoia, ego, and excess to consume everything he built.

movies.title: The Godfather
movies.description: The aging patriarch of a powerful crime family transfers control to his reluctant youngest son, who gradually transforms into the very thing he swore he'd never become.

movies.title: Reservoir Dogs
movies.description: After a diamond heist goes catastrophically wrong, the surviving criminals hole up in a warehouse trading accusations, with the truth of who betrayed them slowly unraveling in non-linear fashion.

movies.title: The Wire
movies.description: A Baltimore drug investigation told from both sides of the law with equal depth and empathy, exposing how broken institutions grind individuals down regardless of which side they're on.

movies.title: Breaking Bad
movies.description: A mild-mannered high school chemistry teacher, diagnosed with terminal cancer, teams up with a former student to cook methamphetamine — and discovers he's terrifyingly good at being bad.

movies.title: The Sopranos
movies.description: New Jersey mob boss Tony Soprano juggles the brutal demands of organized crime with the mundane dysfunction of suburban family life, all while seeing a therapist about his panic attacks.
